style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

The below is ⟦0⟧ player suggested strategies for ⟦1⟧. Bear in mind, due to the dynamic nature of the game, it may unfold differently for other players.

As the Philippines, rush down the monarchist path as fast as possible up to the war for independence. If you're lucky, America will just give you independence without having to do the war - otherwise reset since its relatively early. After independence, just keep allying and attempting to annex as many Hispanic nations as possible, ideally the ones with the most manpower or factories first (Chile, Argentina, Mexico, and Spain). These annexations can actually be savescummed even in ironman mode, but the most critical one is Spain - if they reject annexation/allying, you need to reset or savescum. From here, strategy is dependent on circumstances & preference. If playing on historical mode, you should attempt to Sealion the UK with the Axis - you can join the faction for their assistance flooding troops in after landing/paradropping, but defeating the UK is significantly harder in historical now as a minor nation without tanks or air (though you can at least gain supremacy for a naval invasion prior to declaring war). If you can't kill the UK in historical before the US joins the allies or a dominion becomes a major, you have to defeat them as well. Even if you can kill the UK, you need to have gained enough warscore to annex both the Indian and Malaysian & Indonesian states required for the achievement (this is easier if you keep a separate faction, but then killing the UK before 1941 is even more difficult). As of 1.19.1 not all Indonesian states are required for the "Form Maphilindo" decision, so keep that in mind for the peace deal. Do the "Malayo-Polynesia" focus to get claims on Malaysia and Indonesia and therefore will be cheaper in the peace deal. Also note that the achievement description is misleading, you need specifically the Indian states from the achievement requirements.

Alternatively, an ideal ahistorical mode can lead to an early independent India, which you can simply invade and annex (though you need to be a little creative to get naval range to it). After this, you just need to occupy certain Indonesian/Malaysian states to be able to click the decision, which is a lot easier since it doesn't require a peace deal. Another ahistorical setup that may be easier to manipulate is just one without America in the Allies, which can arise from the communist/democratic/nonaligned Japanese paths. In this scenario, you just need to get strong enough to beat the UK, which allows for more buildup time. Alternatively to all of the above, you can just invade America early after annexing/allying Mexico, which would give you all the resources you need to beat Britain. However, it's hard to get a wargoal on them without them joining the allies anyway, and it's a major detour if you want to actually get the achievement in a reasonable amount of time.
